downstream_selection.nontrivial_heads: From head_index>=16, select four highest mean rotation-only conditional KL and four highest crossfit absolute KL improvement over rotation-only; deduplicate, retain all ties ordered by native read-node ID until count4 for each. downstream_evaluation: For all32 discovery now-cases, run selected heads individually and jointly using each case opposite-fold delta. Compare full native output KL and updated-vs-old token log-odds with zero, mean, fitted and oracle. Actual new-token K/V and native tail are retained.
interpretation: Good attention fit without meaningful output effect is not evidence of the target mechanism.
Improvement over zero but not mean shift supports a simple empirical transition, not an advantage for KL fitting.
Layer0 constancy follows token-local query construction; not algorithm discovery.
Failures of constant shift motivate testing omitted contextual control; do not simply tune forever.
next_gate: Freeze actual artifact/head selection and intervention protocol before accessing lexical heldout outputs; then test new entities/payloads/wording and native finite edits without refitting.
method_target: Recover learned control/content distinction and reusable native laws; this bounded candidate is a diagnostic toward that target, not a redefinition of success.
